utterances.text: Pause am. Ask before you pay. A payment decision companion for Nigerians. This real mobile recording has separate Nigerian English narration.
Choose Speak and agree to audio processing. Ask in your own words, then listen to the recording or discard it before transcription.
Official N C A I R Nigerian accented English A S R transcribes the audio. The actual transcript appears on screen.
Review the transcript, correct errors and confirm it. Leave out account details, passwords, P I Ns and secret codes.
For this supplier request, pause payment and confirm the changed details through an established contact. If you cannot confirm independently, keep payment on hold.
Replay and Stop sit above the text reply. App speech uses device readout; this video's narrator is a separate voice.
If you may have paid a scammer, contact your bank promptly through a verified channel. Keep your payment confirmation and messages private.
The same consented voice journey lets you describe an incident. Here a supplier says the payment was not received.
Review and confirm the incident description. The bank can investigate its records; Pause am cannot establish who committed fraud or guarantee that money will be recovered.
The next steps depend on what your bank has done. This example changes from not yet reported to already reported and waiting.
Keep the complaint reference, ask about the resolution date and follow up through the bank's official channel. Use the relevant C B N guidance when escalation is appropriate.
Preview and download the report draft. The user reviews and sends it; Pause am does not submit a bank complaint automatically.
Learn helps with warning signs and verified bank information. Its security updates are selected, dated official notices, rather than a live stream of every new scam.
Here, the user asks for U B A customer care. After transcription, they correct the bank name before sending. Recognition errors should always be checked.
Bank contact answers come from reviewed official bank pages. The model does not invent a phone number or treat a contact in a suspicious message as verified.
The actual U B A result is now visible. Check the official bank source independently before making contact.
A second bank example asks for G T Bank's customer care email. Again, the recording is transcribed, reviewed and corrected before the question is sent.
Ordinary payment questions can use voice or text. This recording shows the voice path. Typed answers in the product stay silent.
The returned G T Bank email is linked to an official bank source. The screen shows the genuine result from this recording.
N atlas supplies A S R and text inference. This build supports English; other languages are paused. The separate demo narrator is Microsoft Nigerian English speech, not N atlas speech generation.
